whatsNew.title: What's new

intro.title: Make Musclog your own
intro.description: A few things have changed. Take a quick look and choose what works for you. Changes save as you tap; you can revisit this tour in Settings.
intro.truncated: We’ve kept this tour to the latest highlights.

whatsNew.saveFailed: Couldn’t save this choice. Please try again.
whatsNew.dismissFailed: Couldn’t save your progress. Please try again.

settingsCard.title: What's new
settingsCard.subtitle: Revisit the latest features and preferences

view.title: Your workout, your view
view.description: Guided view now helps you focus on one set at a time. Prefer the full picture? Inline view is still here.

workoutView.title: Choose your workout view
workoutView.description: You can change this later in visual settings.

guided.label: Guided
guided.description: Focus on your current set with larger controls.

inline.label: Inline
inline.description: See and edit your sets together in a list.

targets.title: Targets that fit you and your gym
targets.description: Musclog suggests starting targets from your history and marks the numbers it changed, so you can always edit them. Add your gym’s bar and plates to get loads you can actually put on the bar.

workoutAutonomy.title: Starting targets
workoutAutonomy.description: How your history shapes the next workout.

suggest.label: Suggest targets
suggest.description: Use progression suggestions when starting a workout.

manual.label: Keep my plan
manual.description: Start with the targets saved in my workout.

review.title: One weekly moment to reflect
review.description: Weekly Review brings your nutrition and training together, with suggestions you choose whether to apply.

reviewWeekday.title: Your review day
reviewWeekday.description: Pick a day that fits your routine. Existing reminder preferences stay in place.

plans.label: Workout plans
plans.description: Organize workouts into weekly or rotating plans.

cardio.label: Cardio log
cardio.description: Record cardio sessions alongside your strength training.

swaps.label: Exercise swaps
swaps.description: Swap an exercise during a workout without changing the original plan.

restrictions.label: Exercise restrictions
restrictions.description: Remember exercises to avoid and temporary injuries in workout settings.

warmups.label: Warm-up sets
warmups.description: Keep warm-ups separate from your working sets.

restTimer.label: Automatic rest timer
restTimer.description: Start the rest timer after each set, with optional vibration.

heatmaps.title: Your activity at a glance
heatmaps.description: See the days you trained and logged meals as a calendar of squares on Home: darker means busier, and tapping a square reads out that day. Turn it on in Settings → Appearance and home → Home heatmaps, where you also pick the layout.

aiSetup.title: Set up Musclog by talking
aiSetup.description: Answer a few questions in a chat instead of filling in forms, using free Musclog AI, your own Gemini or OpenAI key, or ChatGPT or Claude. You review and edit every answer before anything is saved.

coachPersona.title: Pick who your AI coach is
coachPersona.description: Keep Loggy, or pick Count Dracula, Cthulhu or Sherlock Holmes, or write your own with a name, a voice and a picture. Only the wording changes, never the numbers or the safety advice. Find it in Settings → AI.

home.label: A tidier Home
home.description: Today’s numbers first, smaller shortcuts, and a Weekly Review card only while one is due.

menus.label: Calmer menus and Settings
menus.description: Simple grouped lists instead of stacks of cards, with Settings split into seven clearer groups.

widgets.label: Widgets on iOS and Android
widgets.description: Nutrition Progress and Smart Camera now work on iOS too. On Android, remove your old Musclog widgets and add them again from the widget picker.

lock.label: Lock parts of the app
lock.description: In Settings → App lock, protect your cycle, workouts, nutrition, progress or the whole app with your device credential.

cycleDiary.title: A private, encrypted cycle diary
cycleDiary.description: Your periods and day logs are now encrypted on your device. Predictions show how confident they are, and the fertile-window estimate is optional and off by default. Reminders can be as discreet as you like, and a read-only Cycle widget shows nothing personal under an app lock.
